### Caesars Entertainment Reveals Domestic WSOP Online 2026 Fall Bracelet Schedule


09/17/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 466 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Caesars-Entertainment-Reveals-Domestic-WSOP-Online-2026-Fall-Bracelet-Schedule-2026-0OX-e9qbZo-2026.pdf)


*Series runs Sept. 27 through Nov. 10 with 33 bracelet events, online circuit competition and more than $3 million in online championship guarantees*


**LAS VEGAS (Sept. 17, 2026)** – **** Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) (“Caesars”) today released the domestic schedule for the WSOP Online 2026 fall series. The schedule features 33 coveted bracelet events and will once again operate with pooled liquidity across four major U.S. jurisdictions: Nevada, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Michigan.


The series kicks off with Event #1: NL Hold'em $300K GTD Mystery Bounty on Sept. 27 and includes the return of fan-favorites such as Event #16: NL Hold'em $350K GTD Mystery Bounty Championship on Oct. 18, Event #25: $1,000 Online Championship on Nov. 1, and Event #32: $3,200 NL Hold'em High Roller Championship on Nov. 8.


In addition to bracelet events, the 2026 fall schedule also includes WSOP Online Circuit Events throughout October and November, along with WSOP Online Championships running from Sept. 27 through Nov. 8 featuring more than $3 million in guaranteed prize pools.


The 2026 WSOP Online fall domestic schedule offers a wide range of buy-ins, with events ranging from $333 to $3,200.


“The WSOP Online fall schedule continues to deliver premier online tournament opportunities for poker players,” said Danielle Barille, Vice President of Online Poker at Caesars Digital. “Building on the momentum from this summer's series, WSOP Online sets the standard for online poker by bringing players together in a shared four-state pool and offering the opportunity to compete for the game's most prestigious gold bracelet and gold ring titles under the world's most recognized poker brand.”


For the full WSOP Online 2026 fall schedule and registration details, players can visit:


- Nevada:[www.wsoponline.com/nv/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/](https://www.wsoponline.com/nv/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/)
- New Jersey:[www.wsoponline.com/nj/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/](https://www.wsoponline.com/nj/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/)
- Michigan:[www.wsoponline.com/mi/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/](https://www.wsoponline.com/mi/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/)
- Pennsylvania:[www.wsoponline.com/pa/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/](https://www.wsoponline.com/pa/promotions/fall-bracelet-26/)


Players in the United States must be physically located within the state they are playing. Out-of-state residents can visit[caesars.com](https://www.caesars.com/) for hotel bookings.


All tournaments are subject to changes and cancellations. Please check the WSOP client for the most up-to-date schedule. The WSOP reserves the right to cancel, change, or modify any tournament events, in part or entirely, without prior notice.


*###*


**About WSOP Online** WSOP Online is operated by Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) and is the largest legal real-money poker site in the United States. The site offers thousands of tournaments across Nevada, New Jersey, Michigan and Pennsylvania, including gold bracelet events at the World Series of Poker® flagship event in Las Vegas and in the fall every year. WSOP Online has awarded over $100 million in prize pools since its launch in 2013.


**About Caesars Entertainment, Inc.** Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) is the largest casino-entertainment Company in the U.S. and one of the world’s most diversified casino-entertainment providers. Since its beginning in Reno, NV, in 1937, Caesars Entertainment, Inc. has grown through development of new resorts, expansions and acquisitions. Caesars Entertainment, Inc.’s resorts operate primarily under the Caesars®, Harrah’s®, Horseshoe®, and Eldorado® brand names. Caesars Entertainment, Inc. offers diversified gaming, entertainment and hospitality amenities, one-of-a-kind destinations, and a full suite of mobile and online gaming and sports betting experiences.
